I am farming here in Iringa, and thanks be to God the rains are usually good in our Southern Highlands. My maize plot is small, only 0.12 hectares, but maize is our food so I must care for it well. I will try to buy a little urea if the price is not too high, and I always put manure from our few animals because it helps the soil. I cannot afford to hire people for such a small plot — my children and I will do the weeding ourselves, and we plant our own seed saved from last year, though sometimes I buy a little improved seed when money allows.
